data.content_ref: inline:The extracted_episodes.json (SRC_005) contradicts metrics.json (SRC_003): SRC_005's narrative episodes present qualitative outcomes and decision reversals that are not reconcilable with the aggregate metric counts in SRC_003, because the episode record captures case-level failures that the metrics summary aggregates away or reports as resolved. Refuted if every episode-level outcome in SRC_005 is quantitatively consistent with the aggregate values recorded in SRC_003, with no unexplained discrepancy in failure counts or statuses.
